signature:
Compile the task's one-step action interface into reusable parameterized native command signatures. The runtime will choose parameter values with finite GPU scoring, instantiate several commands in separate branches, execute them, and return the actual action-observation pairs. Later turns use that feedback to select states and act again. This call declares the allowed actions; no trajectory or solution is required.

Output one native command signature per line, covering every command form allowed by the task rules. Fixed native prefixes, separators, spacing and punctuation remain literally in the signature. Replace each variable component with a named slot whose complete finite domain is declared inline: {{name:enum("value_a", "value_b")}} or {{name:range(start, stop)}}. Here range uses integers with an inclusive start and exclusive stop. Independent character positions use {{name:repeat(count, domain)}}; the compiler allocates an independently selected field at every position. The nested domain can be range(...) or enum(...). Reuse an already declared name as {{name}}; repeated use of that name inserts the same selected value. Independent arguments have distinct descriptive names even when their domains coincide. For forms with different argument counts, write separate complete signatures. Literal braces use doubled braces. These are Python Formatter slots with the stated domain expressions; the compiler generates all JSON containers and field IDs.

Declare complete primitive domains from the supplied rules and objects. Named slots occupy their actual positions in the native command, so this single declaration establishes their role and binding together. Parameters that can vary across future states belong in domains even when a particular value is currently inapplicable. Subsequent observations determine applicability and success.

The output consists of the signature lines themselves, with no surrounding string quotes, code fence, labels or explanation. An empty separator is represented by adjacent slots. Fixed whitespace is present literally between slots. A whole sequence of independently variable symbols is expressed as repeated primitive positions, rather than enumerated example sequences.
